claim: Playa de Gulpiyuri is a ~40-metre-long inland beach with white sand fed by the Bay of Biscay through cliff channels; designated a Natural Monument and pedestrian-only with vehicles prohibited.
quote: about forty metres long... the Bay of Biscay is just a few metres away and only flows under the cliffs

claim: Reviewers warn of €100-€200 parking fines for unmarked restricted zones at Gulpiyuri and recommend visiting at high tide; low tide leaves it 'a tiny puddle'.
quote: received €100-€200 fines for parking in unmarked restricted zones... At low tide, it appears as 'a tiny puddle'

claim: Gulpiyuri requires a 400 m walk from a parking area off the A8 at the eastern end of Naves; access from San Antolín beach or Naves village is pedestrian only.
quote: Gulpiyuri is a 400m walk from a parking area just off the A8 at the eastern end of Naves

claim: Playa de Santa Marina in Ribadesella is a ~1 km urban beach with full promenade, lifeguards, amphibious chair, showers, toilets, car/bike parking and chiringuitos; holds the Q for Tourist Quality certification since 2004.
quote: Smoke-free beach | Rescue service | Amphibious chair | Showers | Toilets | Car and bicycle parking | Chiringuitos

claim: Dinosaur footprints are visible at the western end of Santa Marina beach near the Pozu watchpoint in Ribadesella, marked on the vertical cliff face.
quote: the most spectacular and easy to see are the ones near Santa Marina Beach, where the watchpoint Pozu is located

claim: Ribadesella has an 'old town vibe and beach vibe', with a colonial seafront promenade, historic centre, viewpoints and varied restaurants; cider bars and seafood eateries cluster behind the fishing harbour.
quote: Ribadesella with its old town vibe and beach vibe was one of favorite places on the coast of Asturias

claim: Cuevas del Mar is a 125 m triangular cove at the Cuevas River mouth near Nueva (Llanes), famed for karst sea-arches, caves and tunnels carved into limestone; shallow protected water makes it family-friendly.
quote: karst rock formations sculpted by the sea: arches, cracks and cavities that turn the environment into a true geological spectacle

claim: Cuevas del Mar has a large car park, rescue service (Jun 14–Sep 8), showers, toilets and catering; moderate waves and considered safe for swimming; pets prohibited Jun 1–Sep 30.
quote: Rescue service | Showers | Toilets | Parking | Catering service

claim: Playa de Vega is a ~2 km surf beach with rare preserved dune system, Jurassic clay cliffs and unique European fluorite deposits; powerful waves create dangerous swimming conditions but ideal surf with breaks like 'Superman' on the east end.
quote: ideal for surfing, with consistent swells and breaks like 'Superman' peak at the eastern section

claim: Vega works on all tides with right and left peaks along the full 1.5 km of beach; northwest-facing pickup and rarely crowded even when waves are firing.
quote: right and left peaks along the entire beach that work well with all tides... Even when there are waves, it's not likely to be crowded

claim: Playa de San Antolín is a 1200 m beach next to the Romanesque church of San Antolín de Bedón with large car park, viewpoint and surf services; highly dangerous for bathing due to strong waves but popular with surfers.
quote: highly dangerous for bathing due to its exposure to strong waves, but it is very popular with surfers

claim: San Antolín is a sheltered beach break working year-round, best on northwest groundswells with offshore south winds and around low-to-rising tide; eastern part holds tubing rights.
quote: Best around low tide when the tide is rising... The eastern part usually has the best waves, with quite tubing rights

claim: Arriondas to Ribadesella is roughly 19–21 km by road, about 19–22 minutes' drive.
quote: driving distance between Arriondas and Ribadesella is 21 km, and the drive would take approximately 19 minutes

claim: Arriondas to Playa de Gulpiyuri is about 19.5 miles (~31 km) by road, roughly 28 minutes' drive — borderline at the 30 km limit.
quote: The fastest way to get from Playa de Gulpiyuri to Arriondas is by car, which takes 28 minutes. The distance between Playa de Gulpiyuri and Arriondas is 19 miles
